'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Norman Lansing LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Norman Lansing]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name There Is Good In Him. Norman Lansing / Anastar Reaver, 2014 Worlds Day 2 08/23/14, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Username:''' Anastar Reaver
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
